import ast,hashlib,json,runpy,subprocess
from pathlib import Path
r=runpy.run_path('e2e/execution-suite.py');b=Path('.local/e2e')
c=json.loads((b/'function-code-hash-named-clients-checkpoint.json').read_text());assert c['completed']
report=json.loads(Path(c['archive_report_path']).read_text());pubc=json.loads((b/'function-code-hash-publication-checkpoint.json').read_text());assert pubc['completed']
pub=json.loads(Path(pubc['archive_report_path']).read_text());earlier=[json.loads((b/n/'report.json').read_text()) for n in ['function-code-hash-initial-runtime-failure','function-code-hash-recompression-failure','function-code-hash-qualified']]
program=r'''import hashlib,json,os,re,socket,sqlite3,stat,subprocess,sys
from contextlib import closing
from pathlib import Path,PurePosixPath
from uuid import UUID
assert socket.gethostname()=='infra-serverless'
root=Path('/srv/p2enjoy-serverless');reports=REPORTS;pub=PUBLICATION
sys.path.insert(0,str(root/'e2e'))
from control_database import read_control,control_owner
control_path=root/'state/control.sqlite3'
cmd=['runuser','-u','spark-docker','--','docker','--host','unix:///run/user/1001/docker.sock']
def run(args):return subprocess.check_output(cmd+args,text=True,timeout=30).strip()
for report in reports:
 identifier=report['installation'];assert str(UUID(identifier))==identifier
 for args in [['ps','-aq'],['network','ls','-q']]:assert not run(args+['--filter','label=tech.p2enjoy.serverless.installation='+identifier])
 p=Path(report['work']);assert p.parent==root/'control' and p.name.startswith('function-code-hash-') and not p.exists()
 for directory in report.get('channel_directories',[]):
  p=Path(directory);assert p.parent==root/'control' and p.name.startswith('code-hash-ipc-') and not p.exists()
 for invocation in report['invocations']:
  identifier=invocation['container_id'];assert re.fullmatch('[0-9a-f]{64}',identifier)
  value=subprocess.run(cmd+['container','inspect',identifier],capture_output=True,text=True,timeout=30)
  assert value.returncode==1 and value.stdout.strip()=='[]' and value.stderr.strip()=='Error response from daemon: No such container: '+identifier
named_clients=0
for report in reports:
 for client in report.get('clients',[]):
  name=client['name'];assert re.fullmatch(r'serverless-code-(?:packager|identity)-'+report['installation'][:8]+r'-[0-9]+',name)
  value=subprocess.run(cmd+['container','inspect',name],capture_output=True,text=True,timeout=30)
  assert value.returncode==1 and value.stdout.strip()=='[]' and value.stderr.strip()=='Error response from daemon: No such container: '+name
  named_clients+=1
namespace=pub['namespace_id'];assert str(UUID(namespace))==namespace
functions=sorted(set(pub['function_ids']));assert functions and all(str(UUID(v))==v for v in functions)
archived=[]
with read_control(control_path) as db:
 db.execute('BEGIN')
 n=db.execute('SELECT name,deleted_at FROM namespaces WHERE id=?',(namespace,)).fetchone();assert n and n['deleted_at'] and re.fullmatch('cli-[0-9a-f]{8}',n['name'])
 actual={v[0] for v in db.execute('SELECT f.id FROM functions f JOIN services s ON s.id=f.service_id WHERE s.namespace_id=?',(namespace,))};assert actual==set(functions)
 for identifier in functions:
  f=db.execute('SELECT f.deleted_at,f.active_revision_id,s.deleted_at AS service_deleted FROM functions f JOIN services s ON s.id=f.service_id WHERE f.id=?',(identifier,)).fetchone();assert f and f['deleted_at'] and f['active_revision_id'] is None and f['service_deleted']
 for entry in pub['retained_archives']:
  key=entry['revision_id'];assert str(UUID(key))==key and entry['function_id'] in functions
  row=db.execute('SELECT function_id,stored_bytes,inventory_json,deleted_at FROM revisions WHERE id=?',(key,)).fetchone();assert row and row['function_id']==entry['function_id'] and row['stored_bytes']>0 and row['deleted_at'] is None
  code=root/'state/artifacts'/key/'code';assert code.is_dir() and not code.is_symlink()
  inventory=json.loads(row['inventory_json']);files=[]
  for item in inventory:
   relative=PurePosixPath(item['path']);assert not relative.is_absolute() and '..' not in relative.parts
   p=code/relative
   assert all(not (code.joinpath(*relative.parts[:i])).is_symlink() for i in range(1,len(relative.parts)+1))
   s=p.stat();assert stat.S_ISREG(s.st_mode) and not s.st_mode&0o222 and s.st_size==item['size']
   digest=hashlib.sha256(p.read_bytes()).hexdigest();assert digest==item['sha256'] and oct(stat.S_IMODE(s.st_mode))==item['mode']
   files.append({'path':item['path'],'sha256':digest,'bytes':s.st_size,'mode':item['mode']})
  archived.append({'revision_id':key,'function_id':entry['function_id'],'stored_bytes':row['stored_bytes'],'files':files})
 for query in ['SELECT count(*) FROM functions WHERE deleted_at IS NULL','SELECT count(*) FROM execution_instances','SELECT count(*) FROM function_operations',"SELECT count(*) FROM invocations WHERE state IN ('receiving','queued','admitted','running')","SELECT count(*) FROM deployments WHERE state IN ('prepared','receiving','validating')"]:assert db.execute(query).fetchone()[0]==0
 assert db.execute('PRAGMA integrity_check').fetchone()[0]=='ok' and not db.execute('PRAGMA foreign_key_check').fetchall()
settings={}
import shlex
for line in Path('/etc/spark/env').read_text().splitlines():
 parts=shlex.split(line,comments=True)
 if len(parts)==1 and '=' in parts[0]:
  k,v=parts[0].split('=',1)
  if k=='SERVERLESS_STORAGE_ROOT_HOST':settings[k]=v
storage=Path(settings['SERVERLESS_STORAGE_ROOT_HOST'])
with control_owner(control_path):
 with closing(sqlite3.connect('file:'+str(storage/'registry.sqlite3')+'?mode=ro',uri=True)) as db:
  for key in functions:
   row=db.execute('SELECT state,pending_json FROM functions WHERE id=?',(key,)).fetchone();assert row and row[0]=='purged' and row[1] is None
   assert not db.execute('SELECT 1 FROM volumes WHERE function_id=?',(key,)).fetchone() and not db.execute('SELECT 1 FROM leases WHERE function_id=?',(key,)).fetchone()
  assert db.execute('SELECT count(*) FROM leases').fetchone()[0]==0
for key in functions:
 for folder in ['backings','mounts']:assert not os.path.lexists(storage/folder/key)
embedded={}
for name in ['p2enjoy-adapter:dev','p2enjoy-adapter-e2e:dev']:
 code='import hashlib,json;from pathlib import Path;print(json.dumps({p.name:hashlib.sha256(p.read_bytes()).hexdigest() for p in Path("/app/adapter").glob("*.py")}))'
 embedded[name]=json.loads(run(['run','--rm','--name','serverless-adapter-source-verification-'+__import__('uuid').uuid4().hex,'--network','none','--read-only','--cap-drop','ALL','--memory','128m','--pids-limit','32','--entrypoint','python',name,'-B','-c',code]))
print(json.dumps({'completed':True,'runtime_proof_installations_checked':len(reports),'runtime_containers_absent':sum(len(v['invocations']) for v in reports),'named_clients_absent':named_clients,'runtime_work_and_channels_absent':True,'functions_deleted_storage_purged':len(functions),'namespace_deleted':namespace,'retained_code_archives':archived,'agent_leases_absent':True,'active_control_resources_absent':True,'embedded_adapter_sources':embedded}))
'''.replace('REPORTS',repr([*earlier,report])).replace('PUBLICATION',repr(pub))
v=subprocess.run(r['SSH']+['root@10.77.0.24','python3 -B -'],input=program,text=True,capture_output=True,timeout=180)
if v.returncode:raise RuntimeError('Native collection failed: '+v.stderr[-2000:])
native=json.loads(v.stdout);assert native['completed'] and len(native['retained_code_archives'])==33
for module in native['embedded_adapter_sources'].values():
 expected={p.name:hashlib.sha256(p.read_bytes()).hexdigest() for p in Path('adapter').glob('*.py')};assert module==expected
node=next(n for n in ast.parse(Path('.local/collect-invocation-domain-physical.py').read_text()).body if isinstance(n,ast.Assign) and any(isinstance(t,ast.Name) and t.id=='program' for t in n.targets));script=ast.literal_eval(node.value)
installation=json.loads(subprocess.run(r['SSH']+['root@10.77.0.24','python3 -B -'],input=script,text=True,capture_output=True,check=True,timeout=120).stdout)
baseline=json.loads((b/'invocation-source-ui-physical.json').read_text())['installation']
assert installation['services']==baseline['services'] and installation['official_sha256']==baseline['official_sha256'] and installation['routes']==baseline['routes'] and installation['agent_active']
snapshot=r['snapshot']('control/function-code-hash-proof.json',True,include_adapter=True);assert snapshot['source_sha256']==c['after']['source_sha256'] and snapshot['adapter_images']==c['after']['adapter_images']
result={'completed':True,'native':native,'installation':installation,'snapshot':snapshot,'source_files':len(snapshot['source_sha256']),'read_only_collection':True}
(b/'function-code-hash-physical.json').write_text(json.dumps(result,indent=2)+'\n');print(json.dumps({'completed':True,'native_runtime_invocations_absent':native['runtime_containers_absent'],'functions_deleted_storage_purged':native['functions_deleted_storage_purged'],'retained_code_archives_verified':33,'services_configuration_routes_unchanged':True}))
